clips.name: idle_h
clips.note: standing idle: breathing sway; the crescents and flakes bob (phase); crest sways

clips.name: step_h
clips.note: short strafing step (0.1-0.15 b/t, the module moves the anchor)

clips.name: run_h
clips.note: burst-run (0.6-0.8 b/t for about 5 t): body 30 degrees forward, fans swept back, crescents trailing

clips.name: back_h
clips.note: backing off at walking pace (the anchor moves back)

clips.name: turn_h
clips.note: after groggy: turns from her back (root yaw 180, the groggy_h facing) to the anchor facing

clips.name: kick_combo
clips.note: H1 달빛 발차기: burst-run in (0-5), rising flip kick at 8, backflip, 12 t sideways-hop wind-up, flying leap, axe kick at 40, landing

clips.name: kick_jump
clips.note: H2 달빛 점프: the crescent chain lines up at her left and glows (tell 0-13), 360 degree low sweep 13-19, spiral jump at 33, the orb forms at 45 (disc = orb), kicked down at 52, impact 55, landing 59

clips.name: dash_kick
clips.note: H3 달빛 돌진: mote charge 0-10, dash 5-6 b in 2 t (10-12, the module moves the anchor), lunge kick at 15, the ring at 19

clips.name: vacuum
clips.note: H4 광폭한 진공: crouch 9 t, glint, stomp-kick launches the vertical blade at 17, backflip airborne 17-38

clips.name: groggy_h
clips.note: groggy (300 t in the pattern): motionless idle with her back turned (root yaw 180), fans drooped, crescents hidden

clips.name: entrance
clips.note: hidden inside the cocoon prop until the burst at 79 (rig/prop/cocoon); she drops from 4 b, lands at 90 and stands up by 106

clips.name: transform
clips.note: human -> butterfly: the cocoon glow (core), folded wings at 4, light sphere at 6 (달빛 고치 is applied there), the wings unfold over 8 t (4-12), hover lift; the form switches to butterfly at 4

clips.name: idle_b
clips.note: hover flap: forewing leads, hindwing lags 2-3 t, ribbons lag 4 t; body bob ±0.15 b rising on the downstroke

clips.name: glide_b
clips.note: gliding travel: body pitched forward, wings swept back, legs trailing, ribbons streaming

clips.name: wing_strike
clips.note: B1 우아한 날개: bank and climb 0-9, dive 12-15, wing-edge arc hit at 15, climb and flutter

clips.name: wing_barrage
clips.note: B2 화염 날개의 습격 (Pyro look): a 5 t wind-up, then four spinning wing swings at 5/31/69/94, each throwing 5 fire crescents

clips.name: flap_dive
clips.note: B3 날개 휩쓸개 (Pyro look): two big flaps and a rise (0-22), head-first dive (22-26), wing slam at 26, flame fan 28-32, low glide

clips.name: coco
clips.note: B4 달빛 축복: wings wrap forward (charge), orb 1 launched at 19 (rig/prop/orb), the cocoon ball 30-42 (rig/prop/pod), orb 2 at 46

clips.name: release
clips.note: B5 달빛 해제: wings fold, swoop past (0-8), climb, mid-air whirl (2 tumbles 12-28, the star flare at 28), cup (31 = E-22), ground flash 35, X glint 37, ring cage 38-43, the pod wrap (44-52), DETONATION at 53, hover 2 b up, the wings go flat lime and shrink (87) and shatter (91), the human form drops (92) and lands (96); the form switches to human at 92

clips.name: revert
clips.note: butterfly -> human without the blast (the end of 달빛 해제): hover, the wings shrink, go flat lime and shatter, she drops and lands; the form switches to human at 39

clips.name: death
clips.note: she staggers; from butterfly form the wings go flat lime and shrink away over 6 t (the shatter at 6) while she sinks to the floor; she kneels, then dissolves into rising motes (scale out); call kill after 100. Starts from either form

clips.name: chain_reform
clips.note: the crescent chain re-forms after groggy (hands scale back in, with a flourish)

cocoon.note: the entrance cocoon (3.8 b tall, wrapped wing plates, a glowing lime window, a lime spike) and its glow halo (billboard centre); the module hides it at the burst

pod.note: the wrapped wing pod (코코볼 ball, 달빛 해제 wrap; 3.4 b tall, r 1.4 b) centred on the execution point

orb.note: the 달빛 축복 orb: a 1.7 b lime glass sphere and two gyroscope rings (spin them with transformation keys)

objectives.bfRigT: tick within the clip (anchor; -1 = queued by play)
objectives.bfRigFlat: 1 while a clip shows the temporary flat look
